newsitem.title: USA: Applied Analytical, Teva in license pact.
newsitem.headline: Applied Analytical, Teva in license pact.

text.p: Applied Analytical Industries Inc said Tuesday it had entered into a licensing pact with Teva Pharmaceutical Industries Ltd under which Teva USA has exclusive marketing rights for an undisclosed product with a market size of about $100 million.
Applied Anaytical, a contract research and development company, said it is developing the product and Teva will manufacture and market it on approval by the U.S. Food and Drug Administration.
Applied Anaytical said the consideration includes a license fee and royalties.
